scripts.build:python: rimraf .artifacts/python && uv build --package noxyn-api --out-dir .artifacts/python && uv build --package noxyn-verification-worker --out-dir .artifacts/python
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package noxyn-api alembic -c services/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names console,api,worker --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:console" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.format:check: turbo run format:check && uv run --all-packages ruff format --check services/api workers/verification
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && uv run --all-packages ruff check services/api workers/verification
scripts.openapi:check: uv run --package noxyn-api python -m noxyn_api.export_openapi --check && pnpm client:check
scripts.openapi:generate: uv run --package noxyn-api python -m noxyn_api.export_openapi && pnpm client:generate
scripts.test: turbo run test && uv run --all-packages pytest
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && uv run --all-packages mypy services/api/src services/api/tests workers/verification/src workers/verification/tests
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm openapi:check
